recipe.fine_model: Exactly accepted original curved-P2 four-Q K, material, free/fixed reduction and weighted-LS RBE3 b; no replacement/rebuild
recipe.coarse_corner_scope: All original CTETRA corner nodes that are actual free nodes
recipe.prolongation: Corner injection; each unique mid-edge node gets half its two global original endpoint corner values; fixed fine rows removed; vector P is scalar P tensor I3
recipe.global_mapping_guards: No global node may be both corner and midpoint; every midpoint maps uniquely to one unordered original corner edge, every edge to one midpoint; retain all free corners and all fine free rows; record constrained-mid/free-corner nonnested instances
recipe.coarse_operator: Ac=P^T A P by accepted ten-node P2 physical gradients and four positive weights with fixed-row masks in each local P; no straight-P1 geometry/operator
recipe.assembly: FP64 CUDA sparse COO coalesce then CSR; no CPU scientific fallback

coarse_inverse.gamma: max absolute row-sum of B=diag(Ac)^(-1/2) Ac diag(Ac)^(-1/2)

recipe.preconditioner: Dfine_block^-1 + P Sc P^T; both coefficients1, fixed during ordinary PCG

algebra_guards.guard_policy: One real construction only: sparse symmetry, positive diagonal/Gamma, fixed-W symmetry and positive energies on two fixed random vectors, Ac action vs P^T A P on those same two vectors; necessary numerical guards not full global SPD proof

comparison.reference_role: Already converged same-system physical displacement; approximate numerical reference, not GT

cost.primary: Accounted single-query cold: inherited accepted fine input/operator setup + actual new case wall including cache read, construction/guards/write, solve/checkpoints, endpoint and numerical-reference checks + common stage metadata
cost.secondary: Actual cumulative new stage wall and cached solve reported separately; no amortized setup replaces primary gate
cost.zero_reference_cost: Frozen old cold minus its one GT_read_and_metrics phase

selection_gate.failure_policy: No fixed32 parameter/sample/budget rescue; close this exact existing-five candidate on failed gate, not all AMG

read_policy.allowed_scientific_reads: Accepted target-free input cache and operator arrays; committed PCG/coarse checkpoints; two old same-system numerical reference predictions only
read_policy.excluded: Raw canonical target members, raw original fields/decks rereads, old final and sealed new test, neural weights

campaign_budget.prior_policy: max(existing_extension_campaign_prior,parent_actual_seconds), never reset or add parent twice

recipe.units: mm, N, MPa, displacement mm, strain dimensionless
recipe.continuum: isotropic small-strain linear elasticity, full TET10 displacement and curved geometry
recipe.quadrature: four symmetric (a,b,b,b) permutations; a=(5+3sqrt(5))/20, b=(5-sqrt(5))/20; each weight1/24
recipe.integration_claim: Explicit approximate curved-P2 quadrature; not exact integration or OptiStruct equivalence

reader_scope.reduction: u=Tz with free-node identity blocks and exact derived-zero supported translations; no role-flag constraints
reader_scope.rbe3: One loaded reference, translational member Ci=123, positive actual weights, no UM; published weighted-LS rigid-fit is an explicit new approximation
reader_scope.control_policy: Parse all small/free-field cards. Record explicitly allowlisted output/static-irrelevant controls. Do not reproduce original numerical/integration/autoconstraint settings. Unknown active material/load/constraint/contact cards cause an explicit unsupported result
reader_scope.grid_ids: Actual canonical GRID IDs map to original H5 rows; no ID-1 assumption or nearest-node remapping
reader_scope.ctetra_check: Every cached cell covered by deck CTETRA/material, preserving full corner-midpoint edge associations

CHECKEL NO recorded but own mathematical guards retained. RENUMOK YES recorded without input resequencing or geometry repair. PRINFACC 1 output only.
